experimental_conditions.description: Descriptions by subjects of affective states corresponding to 32 emotion labels were input into a computer program.

proposed_method.name: Computer program (Frijda & Swagerman, 1987)
proposed_method.description: A computer program was evaluated using descriptions by subjects of affective states corresponding to 32 emotion labels.

primary_performance.metric: Hit rate for the first choice
primary_performance.experimental_condition: Descriptions by 30 subjects of affective states corresponding to 32 emotion labels

additional_results.metric: Hit rate for the first five choices
additional_results.condition: Descriptions by 30 subjects across 32 emotion labels

additional_results.metric: Chance percentage for the first choice
Chance percentage for the first five choices

dataset.statement: When given the descriptions by 30 subjects of affective states corresponding to 32 emotion labels, the computer achieved a hit rate of 31% for the first choice and of 71% for the first five choices (with chance percentages of 3% and 17%, respectively; Frijda & Swagerman, 1987).
